Use rvr-dev (CLI) / rvr-dev-mcp (MCP) for local testing — never the prod `rvr` binary in dev. Beta channel is `rvr-beta` (currently 1.0.0-beta.3). Stable is `rvr` (1.0.0). This project's own .mcp.json points its MCP server at the stable `rvr` binary as of 2026-05-07 (commit 4b3555d). Release: git tag triggers CI.

rvr-dev / rvr-dev-mcp were renamed from cclid / cclid-mcp on 2026-05-07 as part of the rebrand sweep.
